title: Chilfa bar Agra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 105b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.105b.8) and [Tosefta Bava Kamma, end of chapter 9](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Bava_Kamma.9.11): Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar says in the name of Chilfa bar Agra, who spoke in the name of Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri. In [Derekh Eretz Rabbah, chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tractate_Derekh_Eretz_Rabbah.1.13): Abba Chalfi says in the name of Abba Chagrat, his father. Hyman suggests that these are forms of the name of one Tanna.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Shabbat gives Chilfa bar Agra, while the Tosefta gives Rabbi Chalfai ben Agra within the same transmission from Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri. Derekh Eretz Rabbah gives Abba Chalfi quoting his father Abba Chagrat in a different saying. Hyman is proposing an identification between forms.
